# CA EliteLube

> CA EliteLube Inc, a CA Traders company, is a B2B wholesaler of automotive lubricants, fluids, filters, and shop supplies for mechanics, auto shops, and dealerships in Southwestern Ontario, Canada.

The service area extends from Windsor and Chatham-Kent through London to Kitchener-Waterloo. Request a wholesale quote for current pricing and availability. Sales: sales@caelitelube.com or +1 647-548-6042. Business hours: Monday through Saturday, 8am to 6pm.

## Website and catalog

- [Home](https://caelitelube.com/): Business overview and contact information.
- [Product catalog](https://caelitelube.com/products): Browse products and their published specifications.
- [Engine oils](https://caelitelube.com/categories/engine-oils): Wholesale engine oil category.
- [Coolants](https://caelitelube.com/categories/coolants): Automotive coolants.
- [Transmission fluids](https://caelitelube.com/categories/transmission-fluids): Transmission fluid category.
- [Filters](https://caelitelube.com/categories/filters): Automotive filters.
- [Additives and chemicals](https://caelitelube.com/categories/additives-chemicals): Automotive additives and chemicals.
- [Shop supplies](https://caelitelube.com/categories/shop-supplies): Supplies for automotive shops.
